statement: Pinned Linux hid-nintendo decodes the left stick from the three-byte 12-bit X/Y field, normalizes with left-stick calibration, emits X on ABS_X and inverted normalized Y on ABS_Y, and does not parse the right-stick field for a left-type Joy-Con.
